agent.problem: The opening card has four sentences: two telling the passage and two for the prophet-at-the-bedside joke. The opening card is limited to three sentences.

rule.text: The opening card can be up to 3 sentences.

agent.problem: This story card has three sentence units: "That's the message.", "Straight, no sprinkles.", and "So Hezekiah turns his face to the wall." A non-opening story card is limited to one or two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

agent.problem: The question is not self-contained. "Them" refers to the people around the king, who are identified only on the preceding story card, which is no longer on screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
